limitations.title: Brand-safety risk from unsuitable AI-generated content
limitations.explanation: 56 % of media experts name ad adjacency to AI-generated content as a top challenge, and 40 % say rising volumes of unsuitable Gen-AI content are a serious threat to media quality . On social platforms alone, 73 % expect the surge in AI content to require close monitoring .
limitations.mitigation: Deploy AI-driven classification and context-control tools, pair campaigns with third-party measurement, and create clear brand-suitability frameworks before activating against Gen-AI inventory.

limitations.title: Exposure to made-for-advertising (MFA) sites and ad fraud
limitations.explanation: Digital display and programmatic inventory remain vulnerable to fraud and MFA domains, which 29 – 35 % of experts flag as serious threats . IAS highlights the need to block MFA and cluttered sites at scale .
limitations.mitigation: Use pre-bid fraud/MFA filters, continuously audit supply paths, and rely on vendors whose detection models are trained on authoritative MFA lists.

limitations.title: Quality and transparency gaps in Connected TV (CTV)
limitations.explanation: 82 % of experts expect brand-safety concerns in CTV to increase, and 76 % foresee higher fraud as ad-supported CTV grows . IAS warns of invalid traffic, geo-mis-targeting and app spoofing that can waste budgets .
limitations.mitigation: Adopt CTV-specific third-party measurement, apply pre- & post-bid fraud filters, and integrate cross-platform frequency controls.

limitations.title: Influencer / creator content suitability challenges
limitations.explanation: 89 % of respondents say the safety of influencer content will be critical for digital-video buys , and 78 % see the same issue on retail-media networks .
limitations.mitigation: Screen creators for past content, apply customised suitability lists, and use frame-level video analysis before and during campaigns.

limitations.title: Measurement & outcome-assessment difficulties across new channels
limitations.explanation: 35 % of publishers/platforms and 29 % of brands cite the ‘ability to assess measurement and outcomes’ as a major challenge in the year ahead .
limitations.mitigation: Standardise KPIs, insist on independent, cross-channel verification, and integrate attention, viewability and carbon metrics into regular reporting.
